programme.title: Nazaré: Making Giants
programme.desc: The world's top big wave surfers go head-to-head on towering waves as the season-long wait is finally over.

credits.actor: Pedro Scooby,Kai Lenny,Lucas Chumbo,Rodrigo Koxa,Justine Dupont

programme.title: Reel Rock
programme.sub-title: Will Moss puts The Gunks on the map after climbing a legendary cliff in the northeastern US
programme.desc: Follows the world's top climbers, alpinists and mountaineers to the wildest places on Earth. New stories of triumph, failure and redemption unfold as they pursue the thrill of adventure.

programme.title: No Contest: Off Tour
programme.sub-title: While Japan is known for both tradition and technology it's also an archipelago lashed by swell and steeped in surfing culture. Kanoa Igarashi takes you to Tokyo to get a taste of the action
programme.desc: Exploring the communities of surfing's international hot zones. Includes a look at Italy, Fiji, urban surf cities like NYC and Tel Aviv, and the jungles of Central America and South Brazil.

programme.title: Reel Rock
programme.sub-title: Belgian big-wallers must endure a raging storm and their demons on an 18-day quest for the summit
programme.desc: Follows the world's top climbers, alpinists and mountaineers to the wildest places on Earth. New stories of triumph, failure and redemption unfold as they pursue the thrill of adventure.

programme.title: Skate Tales
programme.sub-title: Madars meets Japan's underground skate star Kento Yoshioka, also known as Japanese Super Rat
programme.desc: Skateboarder Madars Apse travels the world to skate with and learn from people pushing the culture of skateboarding in their own special way.

programme.title: Red Bull Cerro Abajo
programme.desc: The world's most epic urban downhill MTB race hit beautiful Guanajuato, Mexico, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

programme.title: Beyond the ROX
programme.sub-title: The pressure has peaked for Jake Dearden as he qualifies for the final, new competitors challenge the veterans, and the growth of the women's field proves expert coaching can change the game
programme.desc: The best HYROX athletes uncover what it takes to rise to the top.

programme.title: Natural Heights
programme.sub-title: Janja Garnbret is chasing her tenth world title, and the pressure is unlike anything she has faced before. Will shifting to the outdoors for new motivation help her, or push her closer to cracking?
programme.desc: Follow two parallel stories: climbers battling gravity to conquer new heights, while navigating their journeys off the wall.

programme.title: Chumbo: Made for Big Wave Surfing
programme.desc: Getting a glimpse into surfer Lucas Chianca's incredible life as the Brazilian waterman balances chasing heavy waves around the world with his biggest challenge yet, becoming a father for the first time.

programme.title: A Biker's Ballad
programme.desc: Celebrating the deep-rooted culture of mountain biking by taking a two two-wheeled journey back to where the sport began in Crested Butte, Colorado.

programme.title: WRC: More Than Machine
programme.sub-title: We join the team for round four in Croatia. Adrien Fourmaux returns to the rally he crashed out on in WRC2, while Gregoire Munster puts his trust in the team's weather forecaster

programme.desc: This wildlife documentary follows Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall and a team of experts as they travel across seas to find the world's most extraordinary animal stories. The series focuses on animal intelligence, exploring remarkable behaviours, relationships and actions of various species. In Florida, Hugh discovers the unusual relationship between the predatory alligator and the placid manatee, while zoologist Lucy Cooke travels to Canada to reveal how raccoons are cleverly adapting to city life. Biologist Patrick Aryee is in Cambodia to explore why the Sun Bear is one of the world's shrewdest animals and conservationist Giles Clark discusses elephants and emotional intelligence while in Kenya.

programme.title: Material Witness
programme.desc: The FBI suspects' fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. The deaths all point to the work of a hired hit man, with possible links to Margolies, but it will take the concentrated efforts of federal agents to untangle the web of clues to convict the killers.

credits.actor: Mark Joy (Donald Nash),Carl Burrows,Keith Michael Gregory,Michael McKennitt,Tim L. Smith

Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. The deaths all point to the work of a hired hit man, with possible links to Margolies, but it will take the concentrated efforts of federal agents to untangle the web of clues to convict the killers.

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Whether the protagonist is a Batsquatch, Skunk Ape, Mothman or Chupacabra, tales of mysterious creatures and unexplainable phenomena have been passed down generations. \"Monsters and Mysteries in America\" takes a trip across the U.S. to reveal the most cryptic, frightening and brow-furrowing stories. Each hourlong episode focuses on a specific region and the lore of residents who claim to have encountered legendary monsters, ancient spirits or alien beings. With America's dense forests, desert grasslands, and hundreds of miles of uninhabitable wilderness, could it really house -- or hide -- so many mysterious creatures?

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: टेलीशॉपिंग
programme.sub-title: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को प्रदर्शित करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे आराम से खरीदा जा सकते हैं।.

programme.title: बबलू डबलू एए
programme.sub-title: To save their forest from the selfish motives of a logger, two bear brothers embark on various risky adventures to thwart his schemes
programme.desc: एक लकड़हारे के स्वार्थी इरादों से अपने जंगल को बचाने के लिए, दो भालू भाई उसकी योजनाओं को विफल करने के लिए विभिन्न जोखिम भरे साहसिक कार्य करते हैं।.

programme.title: टेलीशॉपिंग
programme.sub-title: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home
programme.desc: प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को प्रदर्शित करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे आराम से खरीदा जा सकते हैं।.

programme.title: यस बॉस
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्येक्रम।.

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

credits.actor: Bhavika Sharma (Santosh \"Santu\" Sharma),Gulki Joshi (Haseena Mallik),Sonali Pandit Naik (Pushpa Singh),Yukti Kapoor (Karishma Singh),Rahil Azam (Anubhav Singh),Ajay Jadhav (Billu Champat),Yashkant Sharma (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi),Priyanshu Singh (Cheteshwar \"Cheetah\" Chaturvedi)

programme.title: हनी बनी व़ाइटी
programme.sub-title: Honey and Bunny, two pet cats, engage in various adventures with other pets when Miss Katkar, their owner, goes out of the house
programme.desc: दो पालतू बिल्लियाँ हनी और बनी, जब उनकी मालकिन मिस काटकर घर से बाहर जाती हैं, तो वे अन्य पालतू जानवरों के साथ कई तरह के रोमांच में शामिल हो जाती हैं।.

programme.title: गुरु और भोले
programme.sub-title: Two close friends, Guru and Bhole, live in the quaint little town of Surtaal Nagar in North India. They always end up in sticky situations but have a musical adventure while trying to get out of it
programme.desc: दो जिगरी दोस्त गुरु और भोले, उत्तर भारत के एक अनोखे और पुराने छोटे शहर, सुर-ताल नगर में रहते हैं। वे अक्सर किसी न किसी मुसीबत में फँस जाते हैं लेकिन साहसिक कारनामे करते हुए उनसे बहार निकल आते हैं।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: 12 ज्योतिर्लिंग दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Devotees come together to participate in a pilgrimage to visit the 12 Jyotirlingas, which are considered a divine manifestation of Lord Shiva
programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: ஆசை 100 வகை
programme.sub-title: A series of dramatised re-enactments of cases revolving around various horrifying and unscrupulous activities that conspire in society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தில் சதி செய்யும் பல்வேறு திகிலூட்டும் மற்றும் நேர்மையற்ற செயல்களைச் சுற்றியுள்ள வழக்குகளின் தொடர்ச்சியான நாடகமாக்கப்பட்ட மறு-நடவடிக்கைகள்.

programme.title: மிக்ஸ்டேப் பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular and beloved musical numbers from the year, played consecutively
programme.desc: வருடத்தில் மிகவும் பிரபலமான மற்றும் பிரியமான சில இசை எண்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு, தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, the young son of Devaki and Vasudeva, embarks on a series of adventures where he befriends the people of Vrindavan, his hometown, and saves them from difficulties.

credits.actor: Nimai Bali,Meet Mukhi,Sachin Shroff,Deshna Dugad,Ram Awana

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: மூவி
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: திரைப்படங்களில் சிறந்தவை.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: பாக்யஜாதகம்
programme.sub-title: Indulekha, a woman who gets a chance to reunite with Parvathy, her long-lost mother, after being abandoned by her own relatives at an early age
programme.desc: இந்துலேகா சிறு வயதிலேயே தன் சொந்த உறவினர்களால் கைவிடப்பட்ட பிறகு, நீண்ட நாட்களாகப் பிரிந்திருந்த தன் தாய் பார்வதியுடன் மீண்டும் இணையும் வாய்ப்பைப் பெறுகிறார்.

programme.title: அலாதின்

programme.title: ది క్విక్ అండ్ ది స్లో
programme.sub-title: Hitting the gas with hawks, cheetahs, and other speed demons to learn why first-in-class acceleration can be an evolutionary advantage, then pumping the brakes with Earth's biggest slowpokes to see why, sometimes, slow and steady wins the race
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతువుల వేగాల వర్ణపటాన్ని పరిశీలిస్తూ, ఈ విరుద్ధమైన ప్రవర్తనలను రూపొందించే పర్యావరణ కారకాలను పరిశీలిస్తారు.

programme.title: బర్త్ ఆఫ్ స్పీడ్
programme.sub-title: Mountains, rocks and steep cliffs, no place for a predator relying on their speed. But that's exactly where we find our two magnificent Cheetah mothers. Hidden between the mountains, open savannah plains miraculously appear. And on these savannahs
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, తమ పిల్లలను పోషించడానికి, శిక్షణ ఇవ్వడానికి ప్రయత్నించే రెండు తల్లి చిరుతల ప్రయాణాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: నేచర్స్ ఫాస్ట్ ఎటాక్స్
programme.sub-title: In the battle between predator and prey, camouflage and speed often make the difference between life and death, as some of the fastest animals can strike and kill in the blink of an eye
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు తమవేగాన్ని, చురుకుదనాన్ని ఉపయోగించి తమ ఎరను పట్టుకునే వేటాడే జంతువులను చూపడానికి ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా పర్యటిస్తారు.

programme.title: ది వ్యూ ఫ్రమ్ ఆన్ హై
programme.sub-title: Exploring how the meticulously planned architectural features of Saint Petersburg were constructed, with a particular focus on their sacral meanings
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు రష్యాలో రెండవ అతిపెద్ద నగరమైన సెయింట్ పీటర్స్‌బర్గ్ లోని చారిత్రక కట్టడాలు, భవనాల నిర్మాణాత్మక శైలిని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: శ్రీలంక - లెపర్డ్స్ ఆఫ్ యాలా
programme.sub-title: Follow the trials and tribulations of a group of leopards in Yala National Park
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు యాలాలోని చిరుతపులుల సన్నిహిత రూపాన్ని అనిందించి, వాటి ప్రవర్తనలు, మనుగడ ప్రవృత్తిని ప్రదర్శిస్తాడు.

programme.title: గ్లాడియేటర్స్
programme.sub-title: There are clashes over precious resources when the dry season brings a band of gladiators to an African savannah watering hole. There is a lion-elephant territory brawl, an ant raid on a termite mound and a honey badger's dance with a deadly snake
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత నాలుగు పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థలలో జీవితాన్ని నిర్వచించే యుద్ధాలను అన్వేషిస్తూ, జంతురాజ్యంలో తీవ్రమైన పోటీలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ వైల్డ్ బంచ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనా, భౌతిక కోణాలను అలాగే తమ ఎరను ఓడించడానికి ఉపయోగించే వ్యూహాల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: యానిమల్ ఎటాక్ రేట్
programme.sub-title: The filmmakers shed light on some of the deadliest predators in Australia, including reptiles and arachnids with unique biological weapons
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వివిధ క్రూర జంతువుల దాడి విధానాలు, ప్రవృత్తిని వివరిస్తూ, వాటి విచిత్ర లక్షణాలపై అంతర్దృష్టులను అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ క్యాట్స్
programme.sub-title: Sheds light on the wild cats of Africa's numerous challenges and how they adapt to thrive in their environment
programme.desc: క్రూరమైన అడవి పిల్లులు చాలా సవాలుగా ఉన్న ప్రాంతాలలో మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడటానికి తమ అద్భుతమైన నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: ఎ రెస్ట్‌లెస్ ప్లానెట్
programme.desc: With a constantly churning molten core, the planet rearranges continents like pieces of a giant puzzle; each episode focuses on one dramatic geological change and its effects on the wildlife - covering the Americas, Africa, Australia and Eurasia.

programme.title: డెసర్ట్ డైనోసార్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker showcases the biological ingenuity of desert animals that helps them survive in the Namib, one of the harshest places on Earth
programme.desc: భూమిపై అత్యంత కఠినమైన ప్రదేశాలలో ఒకటైన నమీబ్‌ ఎడారిలో జంతువులకు తోడ్పడే జీవసంబంధిత నైపుణ్యాన్ని ప్రదర్శిస్తారు.

programme.title: బర్త్ ఆఫ్ స్పీడ్
programme.sub-title: Mountains, rocks and steep cliffs, no place for a predator relying on their speed. But that's exactly where we find our two magnificent Cheetah mothers. Hidden between the mountains, open savannah plains miraculously appear. And on these savannahs
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, తమ పిల్లలను పోషించడానికి, శిక్షణ ఇవ్వడానికి ప్రయత్నించే రెండు తల్లి చిరుతల ప్రయాణాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ది వ్యూ ఫ్రమ్ ఆన్ హై
programme.sub-title: Exploring how the meticulously planned architectural features of Saint Petersburg were constructed, with a particular focus on their sacral meanings
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు రష్యాలో రెండవ అతిపెద్ద నగరమైన సెయింట్ పీటర్స్‌బర్గ్ లోని చారిత్రక కట్టడాలు, భవనాల నిర్మాణాత్మక శైలిని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వోల్వ్స్ అండ్ లయన్స్: ఓల్డ్ ఎనిమీస్
programme.sub-title: Canids and felines deploy an arsenal of hunting skills. Felines face endurance, while wolves rely on their privileged sense of smell in a constant fight for survival
programme.desc: కుక్క జాతి జంతువులు, పిల్లి జాతి జంతువుల తెలివితేటలు పోల్చి ఏ జాతి ఒక ప్రాంతాన్ని శాసిస్తుందో తెలుస్తుంది.

programme.title: డాగ్స్ ఇన్ ద ల్యాండ్ ఆఫ్ లయన్స్
programme.sub-title: We follow the unforgettable journey of a family of wild dogs in Zimbabwe and witness rarely seen behaviour, from tender moments with newborn pups, to the thrills of hunting wildebeest, to close encounters with their greatest enemy - the lion
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, జింబాబ్వేలోని అడవి కుక్కల అసాధారణ ప్రయాణాన్ని అనుసరిస్తూ, అవి వేటాడే సమయంలో సున్నితమైన క్షణాలను సంగ్రహిస్తారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ వైల్డ్ బంచ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనా, భౌతిక కోణాలను అలాగే తమ ఎరను ఓడించడానికి ఉపయోగించే వ్యూహాల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: లెపర్డ్ డైనాస్టీ: ది రైజ్ ఆఫ్ రాణా
programme.desc: In India's Jhalana Reserve, strength, strategy and survival collide in a wild power struggle. Ageing leopard Bahadur rules until his son, Rana, challenges his dominance. As father and son clash, alliances form, and a new chapter begins.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ అండ్ వండర్‌ఫుల్ డెన్మార్క్
programme.sub-title: Getting up close and personal with Danish wildlife that live in the country's forests. The cameras film inside a fox den with a mother fox and her newborn cubs, and follow a majestic golden eagle whilst it is out hunting
programme.desc: డెన్మార్క్ జంతు రాజ్యంలో జరిగే సంఘటనలు, వన్యప్రాణుల పుట్టుక, మరణం, సంభోగం, ఆకలి, వేట వంటి కథలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: మైండ్ వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Has a look at how animals build shelters that are more complicated than simple nests
programme.desc: వన్యప్రాణ నిపుణులు, వాటి సహజ ఆవాసాలలో వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనలు, వాటి తెలివితేటల సంక్లిష్టతల గురించి వివరంగా తెలియచేస్తారు.

programme.title: ఆన్ ద ట్రయల్ ఆఫ్ స్నో లెపర్డ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the search for snow leopards and records the experiences of experts who witness the rare sight of these animals moving around in rocky landscapes
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు మంచు చిరుతపులి కోసం అన్వేషిస్తూ, ఈ జంతువులు తిరిగే అరుదైన దృశ్యాన్ని చూసే నిపుణుల అనుభవాలను రికార్డు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: బాస్టన్స్ ఆఫ్ ద జెయింట్స్
programme.sub-title: An engrossing journey into the lives of Asian Elephants, and the stunning bio-diverse North Eastern jungles of India around the river Brahmaputra
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, ఈశాన్య భారతదేశంలోని అడవులలో నివసించే ఆసియా ఏనుగుల జీవితాలు, మానవులు, జంతు పరిరక్షణ ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: న్యాచురల్ బార్న్ మాన్‌స్టర్స్
programme.sub-title: Sean travels to Costa Rica and comes face-to-face with a monster born from the jungle, the Brazilian Wandering Spider
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures - from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles - in `Natural Born Monsters'. When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.title: సిబెల్లా - ద మిరాకిల్ చీతా
programme.sub-title: Sibella, a wild cheetah in South Africa, has a near-death experience. Later, after being rescued and brought to Samara, she rises to become one of the most skilled hunters
programme.desc: దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలో మరణానికి సమీపంలో ఉన్న సిబెల్లా అనే అడవి చిరుత రక్షించబడిన తర్వాత వేట పద్దతులను నేర్చుకుంటుంది.

programme.title: ఎ రెస్ట్‌లెస్ ప్లానెట్
programme.sub-title: Covers the formation of the isthmus of Panama between South America and North America, a geological event which changed the course of evolution and world climate
programme.desc: With a constantly churning molten core, the planet rearranges continents like pieces of a giant puzzle; each episode focuses on one dramatic geological change and its effects on the wildlife - covering the Americas, Africa, Australia and Eurasia.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బ్యాటిల్ గ్రౌండ్
programme.sub-title: Animals face challenges when trying to survive in some of the driest, fieriest places on the planet, battling exhaustion and dehydration
programme.desc: Different animals use the terrain and their unique attributes to their advantage and defeat their opponents at each location, becoming masters of communication, camouflage, diplomacy, and combat.

programme.title: యానిమల్ ఎటాక్ రేట్
programme.sub-title: Discovers wildlife with complex biological weapons in South America, including dangerous creatures living in the Amazon Rainforest
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వివిధ క్రూర జంతువుల దాడి విధానాలు, ప్రవృత్తిని వివరిస్తూ, వాటి విచిత్ర లక్షణాలపై అంతర్దృష్టులను అందిస్తారు.

programme.sub-title: Being thin, having black patches on light-coloured fur, hyperventilating and licking itself regularly to evaporate saliva are the cheetah's most effective tricks to cope with its scorching environment
programme.desc: The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ క్యాట్స్
programme.sub-title: Sheds light on the wild cats of Africa's numerous challenges and how they adapt to thrive in their environment
programme.desc: క్రూరమైన అడవి పిల్లులు చాలా సవాలుగా ఉన్న ప్రాంతాలలో మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడటానికి తమ అద్భుతమైన నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.title: టైగర్ ఆన్ ది రన్
programme.sub-title: Follow a young tiger in India that has been forced out of its home territory by another male and has to struggle for survival
programme.desc: తన భూభాగం నుండి బయటికి వెళ్ళిపోయినా చిన్న మగ పులి కుమాల్, అడవిలో జీవిస్తూ, ఎలా పెరిగి, పెద్దదయ్యిందో చూడండి.

programme.title: వండ్రస్ అండ్ వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Life around the planet, including births and deaths, joyous moments and dangerous situations
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అడవిలో అనుభవజ్ఞులైన వివిధ రకాల జంతువులు, వాటి చిన్న సంతానం అడవిలో ఎలా మనుగడ సాగిస్తాయో చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ది లెపర్డ్ రాక్స్
programme.sub-title: In a remote, little-known region of Rajasthan, leopards display astonishing behaviour. A mother, called Neelam, protects her three cubs from roaming adult males
programme.desc: రాజస్థాన్‌లోని ఒకమారుమూల ప్రాంతంలో నీలం అనే తల్లి చిరుతపులి తన పిల్లలను రక్షించుకోవడానికి తన శాయశక్తులా ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది.

programme.title: మౌంటెన్ లయన్: ఘోస్ట్ పిల్లి
programme.sub-title: The ghost cat is one of the most elusive animals roaming the wilderness; adaptable and resilient, these cats dictate a precarious cycle of life for the creatures who share their home; in the mountains above Chile, a mother cat raises her three cubs
programme.desc: ఘోస్ట్ క్యాట్ అనేది అరణ్యాలలో సంచరించే అంతుచిక్కని జంతువులలో ఒకటి; చిలీలోని పర్వత ప్రాంతంలో ఒక తల్లి పిల్లి తన మూడు పిల్లలను పెంచుతోంది.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బై నేచర్
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: నటుడు, ప్రకృతి శాస్త్రవేత్త ఆర్థర్ ఇస్లాస్ అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, వాటికి సంబంధించిన ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ వైల్డ్ బంచ్
programme.sub-title: Experts analyse the methods that animal delinquents use to create fear and chaos
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనా, భౌతిక కోణాలను అలాగే తమ ఎరను ఓడించడానికి ఉపయోగించే వ్యూహాల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్: యాన్ అమేజింగ్ యానిమల్ ఫ్యామిలీ
programme.sub-title: As Patrick Aryee delves into the feline family tree, the biologist witnesses gravity-defying 'catrobatics', tests the speed of a cheetah, and explores the odd-looking Pallas's cat
programme.desc: ఒకజీవశాస్త్రవేత్త, అడవి ప్రాంతాన్ని పాలించే 37 రకాల పిల్లుల విజయాన్ని, వాటి వైవిధ్యమైన కుటుంబ వృక్షాన్ని వెలికితీస్తాడు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్ స్మాల్ వరల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted when the winter floods arrive, and witness a scary encounter that gives leopard mum Sephiri a decision to make

programme.sub-title: Has a look at how animals build shelters that are more complicated than simple nests

programme.title: సిబెల్లా - ద మిరాకిల్ చీతా
programme.sub-title: Sibella, a wild cheetah in South Africa, has a near-death experience. Later, after being rescued and brought to Samara, she rises to become one of the most skilled hunters
programme.desc: దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలో మరణానికి సమీపంలో ఉన్న సిబెల్లా అనే అడవి చిరుత రక్షించబడిన తర్వాత వేట పద్దతులను నేర్చుకుంటుంది.

programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతు రాజ్యంలోని వివిధ జాతుల మధ్య పోటీని డాక్యుమెంట్ చేసి, పోటీ వెనుక ఉద్దేశాలను అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బై నేచర్
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: నటుడు, ప్రకృతి శాస్త్రవేత్త ఆర్థర్ ఇస్లాస్ అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, వాటికి సంబంధించిన ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: జస్ట్ యానిమల్స్
programme.sub-title: Explores the interesting facets, physical features, behaviours and habitats of a wide variety of animal species
programme.desc: చిత్ర దర్శకుడు అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, భౌతిక లక్షణాలు, ప్రవర్తనలు, ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను విశ్లేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: ద జూ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు అంతరించిపోతున్న జాతులను రక్షించడంలో, వన్యప్రాణులను సంరక్షించడానికి బ్రాంక్స్ జూ చేస్తున్న ప్రయత్నాలను చూపుతారు.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: క్రికీ! ఇట్స్ ద ఇర్విన్స్
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: ఆస్ట్రేలియా జంతుశాలలో పనిచేస్తున్న ఇర్విన్ కుటుంబ సభ్యులు జంతువులను జాగ్రత్తగా చూసుకోవడానికి అనేక ఇబ్బందులు పడతారు.

programme.title: జ్యూయెల్స్ ఆఫ్ ద న్యాచురల్ వరల్డ్

programme.sub-title: The filmmaker examines the spectrum of animal speeds and delves into the ecological factors that shape these contrasting behaviours
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతువుల వేగాల వర్ణపటాన్ని పరిశీలిస్తూ, ఈ విరుద్ధమైన ప్రవర్తనలను రూపొందించే పర్యావరణ కారకాలను పరిశీలిస్తారు.

programme.title: బర్త్ ఆఫ్ స్పీడ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker traces the journey of two mother cheetahs, who strive to nurture and train their cubs to survive in the wild
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, తమ పిల్లలను పోషించడానికి, శిక్షణ ఇవ్వడానికి ప్రయత్నించే రెండు తల్లి చిరుతల ప్రయాణాన్ని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: నేచర్స్ ఫాస్ట్ ఎటాక్స్
programme.sub-title: In the age-old battle between predator and prey, subterfuge and speed can be a case of life or death for many animals from tigers to cuttlefish
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు తమవేగాన్ని, చురుకుదనాన్ని ఉపయోగించి తమ ఎరను పట్టుకునే వేటాడే జంతువులను చూపడానికి ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా పర్యటిస్తారు.

programme.title: ది వ్యూ ఫ్రమ్ ఆన్ హై
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the history and architecture of the monuments and buildings in Saint Petersburg, the second-largest city in Russia
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు రష్యాలో రెండవ అతిపెద్ద నగరమైన సెయింట్ పీటర్స్‌బర్గ్ లోని చారిత్రక కట్టడాలు, భవనాల నిర్మాణాత్మక శైలిని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: శ్రీలంక - లెపర్డ్స్ ఆఫ్ యాలా
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker provides an intimate look at Yala's leopards, showcasing their behaviours and survival instincts in a park with one of the world's highest concentrations of these magnificent predators
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు యాలాలోని చిరుతపులుల సన్నిహిత రూపాన్ని అనిందించి, వాటి ప్రవర్తనలు, మనుగడ ప్రవృత్తిని ప్రదర్శిస్తాడు.

programme.title: గ్లాడియేటర్స్
programme.sub-title: Battles of the wild include territorial brawl between lions and elephants, ants raiding on a termite mould and a honey badger's face-off with a snake
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత నాలుగు పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థలలో జీవితాన్ని నిర్వచించే యుద్ధాలను అన్వేషిస్తూ, జంతురాజ్యంలో తీవ్రమైన పోటీలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ వైల్డ్ బంచ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker offers detailed insights into the diverse behaviours, survival strategies and hunting tactics of various wildlife
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు విభిన్న వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనా, భౌతిక కోణాలను అలాగే తమ ఎరను ఓడించడానికి ఉపయోగించే వ్యూహాల గురించి తెలియజేస్తారు.

programme.title: యానిమల్ ఎటాక్ రేట్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the calculative attacking instincts of nature's some of the deadliest predators in Australia and their execution of the plan whilst combating the risk
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వివిధ క్రూర జంతువుల దాడి విధానాలు, ప్రవృత్తిని వివరిస్తూ, వాటి విచిత్ర లక్షణాలపై అంతర్దృష్టులను అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ క్యాట్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the predatory moves of the ferocious wild cats of Africa and delves into their daily routine, capturing vivid moments
programme.desc: క్రూరమైన అడవి పిల్లులు చాలా సవాలుగా ఉన్న ప్రాంతాలలో మనుగడ కోసం పోరాడటానికి తమ అద్భుతమైన నైపుణ్యాలను ఉపయోగిస్తాయి.

programme.sub-title: Wild predators employ a variety of predatory techniques. However, wolves rely upon an excellent sense of smell whilst cats confront stamina issues
programme.desc: కుక్క జాతి జంతువులు, పిల్లి జాతి జంతువుల తెలివితేటలు పోల్చి ఏ జాతి ఒక ప్రాంతాన్ని శాసిస్తుందో తెలుస్తుంది.

programme.sub-title: The filmmaker follows the extraordinary journey of closely-bonded wild dogs in Zimbabwe, capturing their tender moments to wild hunting

programme.title: లెపర్డ్ డైనాస్టీ: ది రైజ్ ఆఫ్ రాణా
programme.desc: In India's Jhalana Reserve, strength, strategy and survival collide in a power struggle; aging leopard Bahadur rules until his son, Rana, challenges his dominance; as father and son clash, alliances form, instincts sharpen.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ అండ్ వండర్‌ఫుల్ డెన్మార్క్
programme.sub-title: Take a look at a yellow-necked mouse that is pursued by an eagle-owl, a mother fox and her newborn cub and a soar with a golden eagle while it is out hunting

programme.title: మైండ్ వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Explore the elements of intelligence as various animals develop wondrous strategies to create nests, safe houses, caves and other constructions
programme.desc: వన్యప్రాణ నిపుణులు, వాటి సహజ ఆవాసాలలో వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనలు, వాటి తెలివితేటల సంక్లిష్టతల గురించి వివరంగా తెలియచేస్తారు.

programme.title: బాస్టన్స్ ఆఫ్ ద జెయింట్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the lives of Asian elephants in the jungles of Northeast India, highlighting conservation efforts to ensure a harmonious future for both humans and wildlife

programme.title: న్యాచురల్ బార్న్ మాన్‌స్టర్స్
programme.desc: Adventurer Sean Duggan heads to some of the most remote places on Earth in search of mysterious creatures -- from land-prowling fish to giant predatory reptiles -- in \"Natural Born Monsters.\" When he unearths the creatures, he investigates how they have adapted to extreme weather conditions to survive in their often-dangerous environments and how weather has shaped the animals themselves. Duggan often enlists the help of local experts to locate and investigate the creatures and get the information he seeks.

programme.desc: భూమిపై అత్యంత కఠినమైన ప్రదేశాలలో ఒకటైన నమీబ్‌ ఎడారిలో జంతువులకు తోడ్పడే జీవసంబంధిత నైపుణ్యాన్ని ప్రదర్శిస్తారు.

programme.title: బిగ్ క్యాట్స్: యాన్ అమేజింగ్ యానిమల్ ఫ్యామిలీ
programme.sub-title: Patrick Aryee begins his American adventure in the tangled jungles of Central America, where he meets the ocelot dynasty
programme.desc: ఒకజీవశాస్త్రవేత్త, అడవి ప్రాంతాన్ని పాలించే 37 రకాల పిల్లుల విజయాన్ని, వాటి వైవిధ్యమైన కుటుంబ వృక్షాన్ని వెలికితీస్తాడు.

programme.title: ది టీత్ ఆఫ్ ది సవన్నా
programme.desc: Explore the African wilderness and learn about the various species that live there.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఎర్త్
programme.desc: From the producers of Walking with Dinosaurs comes an eight-part docuseries spanning 450 million years that revisits eight of Earth's major extinction events. Bringing some of the planet's most extraordinary geological eras to vivid life, the all-new footage created in partnership with real scientific insight explores the lives of animals we know and love, including mammoths, saber-toothed cats and dinosaurs, alongside some of evolution's truly unique creatures, like gorgonopsians, pliosaurs, glyptotherium and more. Together, they tell the story of how life has endured the impossible -- and never stopped fighting for survival.

programme.title: ది లెపర్డ్ రాక్స్
programme.sub-title: In a remote, secluded region of Rajasthan, leopards thrive and exhibit astonishing behaviour. One particular leopard mother, Neelam, does her best to protect her three cubs from wandering adult males
programme.desc: రాజస్థాన్‌లోని ఒకమారుమూల ప్రాంతంలో నీలం అనే తల్లి చిరుతపులి తన పిల్లలను రక్షించుకోవడానికి తన శాయశక్తులా ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది.

programme.title: బీచ్ జకాల్స్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the lives and survival tactics of the groups of black-backed jackals of the Skeleton Coast in Namibia
programme.desc: దక్షిణాఫ్రికా రైతుల తుపాకుల నుండి తప్పించుకోడానికి నమీబియా స్కెలిటన్ కోస్ట్‌లో వేటాడే బ్లాక్-బ్యాక్డ్ నక్కలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: లా విడా ఎన్ ఎల్ ఆఫ్రికా ఆర్డియంటే
programme.sub-title: Take look at some of the tricks employed by cheetahs in order to protect themselves from the scorching sun in the wilderness
programme.desc: The filmmaker sheds light on the threat of the climate change in the hottest regions of the world and how the animals have adjusted themselves to the changing environment.

programme.title: సర్వైవింగ్ ఆస్ట్రేలియా
programme.sub-title: Experts examine the hazards of the Australian shoreline and the risks of deeper waters. Later, survivors share close encounters with dangerous marine predators
programme.desc: ప్రాణాలతో బయటపడినవారు ఆస్ట్రేలియన్ అవుట్‌బ్యాక్ నుండి తాము ఎదుర్కొన్న భయంకరమైన తప్పించుకునే అనుభవాలను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: హిస్టరీ ఆఫ్ లైఫ్ ఆన్ ఎర్త్
programme.desc: Life evolved in the sea, in a water-bound planet, but landmasses slowly appeared, and aquatic life began to explore different ways to colonize it.

programme.title: యానిమల్స్ ఎట్ నైట్
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: ది వ్యూ ఫ్రమ్ ఆన్ హై
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the history and architecture of the monuments and buildings in Saint Petersburg, the second-largest city in Russia
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు రష్యాలో రెండవ అతిపెద్ద నగరమైన సెయింట్ పీటర్స్‌బర్గ్ లోని చారిత్రక కట్టడాలు, భవనాల నిర్మాణాత్మక శైలిని చూపుతారు.

programme.title: Sexy Beasts: The Need To Breed
programme.desc: Sexy Beasts: The Need To Breed.

programme.title: మైండ్ వైల్డ్
programme.sub-title: Explore the elements of intelligence as various animals develop wondrous strategies to create nests, safe houses, caves and other constructions
programme.desc: వన్యప్రాణ నిపుణులు, వాటి సహజ ఆవాసాలలో వన్యప్రాణుల ప్రవర్తనలు, వాటి తెలివితేటల సంక్లిష్టతల గురించి వివరంగా తెలియచేస్తారు.

programme.title: రైజ్ ఆఫ్ జాగ్వర్స్
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the lives of the elusive jaguars, highlighting their intelligence and hunting prowess that make them one of the most formidable predators in the world.

programme.title: సిబెల్లా - ద మిరాకిల్ చీతా
programme.sub-title: Sibella, a wild cheetah in South Africa, has a near-death experience. Later, after being rescued and brought to Samara, she rises to become one of the most skilled hunters
programme.desc: దక్షిణాఫ్రికాలో మరణానికి సమీపంలో ఉన్న సిబెల్లా అనే అడవి చిరుత రక్షించబడిన తర్వాత వేట పద్దతులను నేర్చుకుంటుంది.

programme.title: అమెరికాస్ వైల్డ్ సీజన్స్
programme.sub-title: Nature awakens from its slumber during spring in many forms, from the blossoms that explode in the rain-soaked desert of Arizona to the fuzzy wood ducklings that leap from their nests
programme.desc: ప్రతి సీజన్ లో పర్యావరణంలో వచ్చే అద్భుతమైన పరివర్తనల గురించి తెలుపుతూ, అమెరికాలోని విభిన్న ప్రకృతి దృశ్యాలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: బ్యాటిల్ ఆఫ్ ది ఆల్ఫాస్
programme.sub-title: In Madagascar, the animals battle in an isolated tropical forest. Female lemurs carry their offspring for protection and hold on for dear life with panther chameleons
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు జంతు రాజ్యంలోని వివిధ జాతుల మధ్య పోటీని డాక్యుమెంట్ చేసి, పోటీ వెనుక ఉద్దేశాలను అర్థం చేసుకుంటారు.

programme.title: బ్యాటిల్ ఆఫ్ ది ఆల్ఫాస్

programme.desc: నటుడు, ప్రకృతి శాస్త్రవేత్త ఆర్థర్ ఇస్లాస్ అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, వాటికి సంబంధించిన ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: జస్ట్ యానిమల్స్

programme.desc: जब एक धनी व्यापारी ब्रह्मदत्त को हत्या के झूठे आरोप में दोषी ठहराया जाता है, तो वह अपने क्रूर दामाद और अपने सभी दुखों के कारण इंद्रजीत से बदला लेने के लिए एक लड़के की मदद लेता है।.

programme.desc: Der Anblick einer riesigen, leeren Algengrütze-Vorratsdose bringt Mr. Krabs auf eine Idee: Das Weißblech wird zur Zeitkapsel umfunktioniert und deren Befüllung mit allerlei Erinnernswertem als pofitables Event organisiert. Die mit der Durchführung beauftragten SpongeBob und Thaddäus finden sich durch einen wie üblich absurden Zufall irgendwann ebenfalls in der Zeitkapsel wieder und werden damit begraben. Was tun? // Thaddäus ist mit den Nerven total am Ende. Seine lärmenden Nachbarn SpongeBob und Patrick rauben ihm den letzen Nerv, den Schlaf, ja fast den Verstand. Doch irgendwann erkennen die beiden Blödel, in welch beklagenswertem Zustand Thaddäus sich befindet, und bauen ihm das Land seiner Träume direkt vor die Haustür..

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente
Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Blue Spirit
programme.sub-title: Der blaue Geist
programme.desc: Auf der Reise zum Nordpol werden Sokka und Katara plötzlich krank. Aang sucht nach einem Heilmittel und trifft schließlich auf eine alte Kräuterhändlerin, die ihm den entscheidenden Tipp gibt: In einem nahe gelegenen Sumpf leben Frösche, die ein heilendes Sekret ausscheiden. Aang zieht sofort los, um einige der wertvollen Amphibien zu holen - doch unterwegs wird er von Soldaten der Feuernation überwältigt und gefangen genommen. Alles scheint verloren, bis plötzlich ein blau maskierter Ninja auftaucht und Aang befreit.

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente
Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Fortuneteller
programme.sub-title: Die Wahrsagerin
programme.desc: Im Mittelpunkt von "Avatar - Der Herr der Elemente" steht der zwölfjährige Aang, der in einer von den Herren des Feuers beherrschten asiatischen Fantasy-Welt lebt. Aang ist nicht nur der letzte Herrscher über die Luft, sondern auch der Avatar, der Herr über alle Elemente. Er ist derjenige, der über die Form von Wasser, Erde, Luft und Feuer bestimmt. Doch der Avatar war 100 Jahre lang in einem Gletscher am Südpol eingefroren, und während dieser Zeit sind die Herrscher des Feuers ihrem Ziel der totalen Weltherrschaft immer näher gekommen. Erst als Aang von Katara, der letzten Gebieterin des Wassers, und deren Bruder Sokka aus dem ewigen Eis befreit wird, hat er eine Chance, seine Mission zu erfüllen: Er muss die aus den Fugen geratene Welt retten und die Balance der Elemente wiederherstellen. Eine große Herausforderung für einen Zwölfjährigen - schließlich muss er noch vieles lernen.

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente
Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bato of the Water Tribe
programme.sub-title: Bato vom Wasserstamm
programme.desc: Katara und Sokka treffen sich mit Bato, einem alten Freund ihres Vaters. Während sie darauf warten, dass eine Botschaft vom Südpol eintrifft, erinnern sich die drei an ihre gemeinsamen Zeiten. Aang sieht ihre Vertrautheit mit gemischten Gefühlen: Er glaubt, dass Sokka und Katara ihn verlassen wollen, um gemeinsam mit Bato nach ihrem Vater zu suchen. Als der lang erwartete Bote endlich eintrifft, wird Aang von der Angst überwältigt, seine Freunde zu verlieren. Um sie an der Abreise zu hindern, lässt er sich zu einem Verrat hinreißen, den keiner von ihnen für möglich gehalten hätte..

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente
Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Master
programme.sub-title: Der Meister der Wasserbändiger
programme.desc: Der Avatar und seine Freunde treffen endlich beim nördlichen Wasserstamm ein. Während Aang und Katara sich auf die Suche nach einem Meister des Wasserbändigens machen, lernt Sokka die wunderschöne Prinzessin Yue kennen und verliebt sich in sie. Derweil braut sich in der Feuernation neues Unheil zusammen: Zhao plant einen Angriff auf den nördlichen Stamm und zieht dazu alle Männer von Prinz Suko ein. Der junge Feuerbändiger muss einen anderen Weg finden, um seine Jagd nach dem Avatar fortzusetzen.

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente

programme.sub-title: Die Belagerung des Nordens

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente
Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North, Part 2
programme.sub-title: Die Belagerung des Nordens
programme.desc: Zhaos Invasionsflotte setzt dem nördlichen Wasserstamm übel zu und durchbricht den äußeren Wall der Verteidigungsanlagen. Aang sucht unterdessen Hilfe in der Welt der Geister: Hier haust der Gestaltwandler Koh, der weiß, wie man die übermächtigen Truppen der Feuernation vielleicht doch noch besiegen könnte. Aber Koh hat eine unheimliche Fähigkeit: Er stiehlt jedem das Gesicht, der im Gespräch mit ihm auch nur eine Spur von Gefühlen zeigt. Wird der Avatar die Begegnung mit dem Monster überstehen und rechtzeitig zurückkehren, um Zhao zu stoppen und die Vernichtung des Wasserstamms zu verhindern.

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente 2
Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar State
programme.sub-title: Der Avatar-Zustand
programme.desc: Aang macht sich mit Katara und Sokka auf den Weg nach Omashu. General Fong hat den Auftrag, ihnen eine Eskorte zu stellen. Aber vorher bittet er Aang um Hilfe im Kampf gegen die Feuernation. Dazu soll sich Aang in den Avatar-Zustand versetzen lassen. Er wehrt sich mit Händen und Füßen - aber letztlich vergebens. Prinz Zuko bekommt derweil Besuch von seiner Schwester Azula. Sie bittet ihn, wieder nach Hause zurückzukehren, denn angeblich hat der Feuerlord ihn begnadigt. Zuko und sein Onkel entschließen sich, Azulas Bitte Folge zu leisten. Doch als die beiden Azulas Schiff betreten, werden sie plötzlich wie Gefangene behandelt..

SpongeBob SquarePants: The Abrasive Side / Earworm
programme.sub-title: Die kratzbürstige Seite / Der Ohrwurm
programme.desc: SpongeBob kann einfach nicht nein sagen und ist deswegen unglücklich. Gary will Abhilfe schaffen und bestellt beim Putzmittelhandel eine Scheuerschwammfläche. Die passt SpongeBob wie angegossen, doch seine neue kratzbürstige Seite ist nicht jedermanns Sache... // Der aktuelle Hit "Mein Gedudel" geht SpongeBob nicht mehr aus dem Kopf. Ständig muss er das Lied hören bzw. vor sich hin singen. Dabei unterlaufen ihm zunächst einige Unkonzentriertheiten, mit der Zeit aber treibt ihn der Ohrwurm mehr und mehr in den Wahnsinn. Doch wie vertreibt man diesen Ohrwurm wieder aus dem Schwammkopf.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: Hide and Then What Happens? / Shellback Shenanigans
programme.sub-title: Versteck und Irrtum / Schneckenhaus-Schummeleien
programme.desc: Patrick hat die Regeln des Versteckspiels bzw. dessen Existenz überhaupt vergessen. Dieses Faktum kostet SpongeBob viel Geduld, noch mehr Mühe und eine lange, aber auch lehrreiche Suche... // Anlässlich des "Bring-dein-Haustier-mit-zur-Arbeit"-Tags reift in Plankton ein teuflischer Plan: Er luchst Gary vorübergehend dessen Schneckenhaus ab und gibt sich selbst als SpongeBobs Haustier aus. Der ist jedoch tief geschockt davon, dass sein Schneckchen plötzlich grün ist und reden kann - und so findet sich Plankton bald auf der Intensivstation der Tierklinik wieder..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: The Masterpiece/Whelk Attack
programme.sub-title: Kunst und Krabbe / Verschleimt und verschlungen
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs verliert Kundschaft an ein konkurrierendes Restaurant, das als Attraktion eine Statue des Inhabers als Kinder-Kletterfels aufbietet. Nun will sich auch Mr. Krabs in Stein meißeln lassen. Doch verfolgenden er und Thaddäus als ausführender Künstler wirklich dieselben Interessen? // Eine Horde riesiger Wellhornschnecken droht, ganz Bikini Bottom zu verschlingen - oder wenigstens ordentlich einzuschleimen. Nichts scheint die Monster aufhalten zu können. Da hat Sandy die entscheidende Idee..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 10
SpongeBob SquarePants: The Incredible Shrinking Sponge / Sportz?
programme.sub-title: WinzBob Kleinkopf / Sport?!?
programme.desc: SpongeBob Schwammkopf wohnt mit seiner Schnecke Gary in der Unterwasserstadt Bikini Bottom in einer Zwei-Zimmer-Ananas und arbeitet als Krabbenburgerbrater im Fastfood-Restaurant 'Krosse Krabbe', wo Mr. Krabs sein Chef ist. Neben dem Schwammkopf ist SpongeBobs Markenzeichen die eckige Quadrathose. Seine Freunde sind Tintenfisch Thaddäus, Eichhorn Sandy und Seestern Patrick. Sein Feind ist der fiese Plankton, der an das Geheimrezept der Krabbenburger und die Weltherrschaft gelangen will. Die Serie basiert auf wahren Begebenheiten. Nun, zumindest ist ihr Erfinder Stephen Hillenburg ausgebildeter Meeresbiologe, er müsste also wissen, wie es da unten zugeht.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 3
SpongeBob SquarePants: Born Again Krabs / I Had an Accident
programme.sub-title: Geizig bleibt geizig / Unfallschäden
programme.desc: Sein Geiz, der ihm nicht gestattet, verdorbene Lebensmittel wegzuwerfen, bringt Mr. Krabs ins Grab - doch halt, nicht ganz, denn der Fliegende Holländer verbannt ihn auf ewig in den nach alten Tennissocken riechenden Spind von Davey Jones. Doch Krabs fleht so lange um eine zweite Chance, bis er sie schließlich erhält. Unter einer Bedingung: er muss dem Geiz abschwören und großzügig sein. Das ist er dann auch - nur wie lange? // SpongeBob holt sich beim Snowboarden eine heftige Verletzung am Hintern. Er nimmt die Mahnungen des behandelnden Arztes, zukünftig etwas vorsichtiger zu sein, allerdings so ernst, dass er sein Haus nicht mehr verlässt. Alle Bemühungen von Sandy und Patrick, ihn doch nach draußen zu locken, schlagen fehl - bis sie auf die Idee mit dem Gorilla-Überfall kommen..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 3
SpongeBob SquarePants: Krabby Land / The Camping Episode
programme.sub-title: Sommeranfang / Helden beim Zelten
programme.desc: Der Sommer ist angebrochen, was Mr. Krabs ausgesprochen freut, denn nun haben die Kinder endlos viel Zeit, um ihr Taschengeld in seine Burger zu investieren. Mit billigen Tricks und dem selbstlosen körperlichen Einsatz von SpongeBob gelingt ihm das auch - aber nicht lange... // Thaddäus freut sich sehr, denn SpongeBob und Patrick gehen übers Wochenende zum Camping. Doch wieder einmal macht er die Rechnung ohne den Wirt, denn die beiden schlagen ihr Zelt lediglich ein paar Meter von SpongeBobs - und Thaddäusens - Haus entfernt auf. Da er nicht als Weichei gelten will, schließt er sich den beiden an. Doch als Sponge und Pat wilde Geschichten von dem gruseligen Seebären erzählen, wird's ihm doch zu bunt und er tut alles, um den vermeintlichen Schrecken des Ozeans anzulocken. Der kommt auch prompt - und vertrimmt Thaddäus mächtig..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 3
SpongeBob SquarePants: Missing Identity / Plankton's Army
programme.sub-title: Namenlos / Planktons Verwandtschaft
programme.desc: SpongeBob muss nach einem chaotisch verlaufenen Morgen feststellen, dass sein Namensschild, das ihn als Mitarbeiter der Krossen Krabbe ausweist, fehlt. Das ist schon schlimm für unseren sensiblen Schwamm. Noch schlimmer jedoch ist, dass Mr. Krabs eine Überprüfung der Mitarbeiteruniformen ankündigt. Nun versucht SpongeBob verzweifelt, den bisherigen Tagesverlauf zu rekapitulieren, durchwühlt schließlich sogar eine Mülltonne - nur um final feststellen zu müssen, dass er sehr wohl sein Namenschild trägt und lediglich sein Hemd falsch herum angezogen hat... // Nach diversen Rückschlägen bei seinen Versuchen, an die Geheimformel für die Zubereitung von Krabbenburgern zu kommen, holt sich Plankton Verstärkung in Gestalt seiner bemerkenswert großen Verwandtschaft. Nun zieht eine ganze Armee zur Krossen Krabbe und nimmt das Lokal im Sturm. Und endlich hat Plankton die Geheimformel in der Hand. Doch was er da liest, gefällt ihm ganz und gar nicht..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 3
SpongeBob SquarePants: SpongeBob Meets the Strangler / Pranks a Lot
programme.sub-title: Der Quatschtüten-Würger / Die Geister von Bikini Bottom
programme.desc: SpongeBob bringt den berüchtigten Quatschtüten-Würger gegen sich auf, indem er ihn bei der Polizei anzeigt. Der Würger schwört Rache und SpongeBob sucht nach einem Bodyguard, um ihn vor dem gefährlichen Ganoven zu beschützen. Doch dieser Job ist allen zu heikel, und so gerät er schließlich an den äußerst notdürftig getarnten Würger selbst. Und es kommt, wie es kommen muss: anstatt erwürgt zu werden, treibt unser spinnerter Schwamm den Würger zum Wahnsinn... // In einem Scherzartikelladen kaufen sich SpongeBob und Patrick ein Unsichtbarkeits-Spray. Eigentlich hatten sie ja etwas anderes damit vor, aber aufgrund kleinerer Streitigkeiten sind sie schließlich selbst unsichtbar und beschließen, die Einwohnerschaft von Bikini Bottom als Geister zu erschrecken. Das klappt ganz ausgezeichnet - bis sie's schließlich dann doch übertreiben..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: Fear of a Krabby Patty / Shell of a Man
programme.sub-title: Die Angst vor dem Krabbenburger / Harte Schale, weicher Kern
programme.desc: Die "Krosse Krabbe" hat neuerdings rund um die Uhr geöffnet. Die Kunden freut's, die Angestellten stöhnen: Sie haben von nun an einen 24-Stunden-Job - ohne Pause! Für SpongeBob wird schon allein der Gedanke an Freizeit zur absoluten Traumvorstellung. Doch in seinen Träumen wird er von fiesen Krabbenburgern verfolgt, die ihn ständig davon abhalten, seine Arbeit zu erledigen. Der böse Plankton, Mr. Krabs' Erzrivale, sieht seine Chance gekommen. Er verkleidet sich als Psychiater und bietet SpongeBob seinen Hilfe an. Ob er auf diese Weise endlich das geheime Krabbenburger-Rezept in Erfahrung bringen wird? // Mr. Krabs freut sich auf ein Wiedersehen mit seinen alten Seefahrer-Kumpels. Doch ausgerechnet jetzt meldet sich sein gepanzerter Krabbenkörper: Mr. Krabs steht kurz vor der nächsten Häutung. Die Jahre als Besitzer eines Fastfood-Restaurants haben ihre Spuren hinterlassen, und vor allem um die Taille herum wird's langsam eng. Obwohl er nun nackt und schutzlos ist, kann er es sich unmöglich leisten, bei seinen Kumpels abzusagen. Also bittet er SpongeBob, in seinen alten Panzer zu schlüpfen, um an seiner statt bei dem Treffen zu erscheinen.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: The Lost Mattress / Krabs vs. Plankton
programme.sub-title: Die verlorene Matratze / Krabs gegen Plankton
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs leidet unter Schlafstörungen. Seine alte Matratze ist schuld. SpongeBob hört davon und versucht, seinem Chef zu helfen. Gemeinsam mit Patrick und Thaddäus kauft er eine neue Matratze und wirft die alte weg. Als Mr. Krabs davon erfährt, fällt er ins Koma: All sein Erspartes war in die alte Matratze eingenäht! SpongeBob und Co. setzen alles daran, das Ding vom städtischen Schrottplatz zurückzuholen. Plankton, Mr. Krabs' Erzfeind, taucht in der "Krossen Krabbe" auf. Auf dem frisch gewischten Fußboden rutscht er aus. Prompt verklagt er Mr. Krabs, weil der kein entsprechendes Warnschild aufgestellt hatte. Wenn Plankton in dieser Sache gewinnt, bekommt er alles, was Mr. Krabs besitzt - das geheime Krabbenburgerrezept eingeschlossen. Es gibt nur einen, der den verzweifelten Restaurantbesitzer retten kann: ein Rechtsanwalt namens SpongeBob.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: Have You Seen This Snail?
programme.sub-title: Haben Sie diese Schnecke gesehen?
programme.desc: SpongeBob hat sich in den Kopf gesetzt, den Weltrekord im Paddelball zu knacken. Er trainiert wie ein Wahnsinniger und vergisst darüber Gary, die Schnecke. Wochenlang füttert er das Tierchen nicht. Gary macht sich selbstständig und auf den Weg in die Stadt. In Bikini Bottom wird er von einer freundlichen alten Dame aufgegriffen, die ihn mit einem ihrer verstorbenen Haustiere verwechselt. Sie nimmt ihn mit nach Hause und verwöhnt ihn mit zahllosen Snacks. In der Zwischenzeit bemerkt SpongeBob, dass er seinen Freund vernachlässigt hat. Nach langer Suche kommt er schließlich der alten Dame auf die Spur - und muss feststellen, dass die Lady gar nicht so freundlich ist, wie zunächst angenommen. Gary schwebt in höchster Gefahr..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 7
SpongeBob SquarePants: Krusty Dogs / The Wreck of the Mauna Loa
programme.sub-title: Krosse Dogs / Das Wrack der Mauna Loa
programme.desc: Mehr zum Zeitvertreib formt SpongeBob aus Hackfleischresten ein Würstchen. Bei der Kundschaft stößt die Kreation auf Begeisterung, und bald stellt Mr. Krabs das Angebot voll auf "Krosse Dogs" um - mit der Konsequenz, dass die Krabbenburger von der Karte und der Grill aus der Küche verbannt werden. Dies ist nun gar nicht in SpongeBobs Sinn, und bald beginnt er, Widerstand zu leisten... // Beim Spielen stoßen SpongeBob und Patrick zufällig auf ein altes Schiffswrack. Die Mauna Loa war einst wohl ein Piratensegler und bietet den beiden einen idealen Spielplatz. Doch als Mr. Krabs trotz aller Geheimhaltungsversuche Wind davon bekommt, ist es aus mit der Idylle, denn die Geldgier lässt SpongeBobs Chef einmal mehr alle Hemmungen beiseite wischen..

programme.sub-title: Quallenfischendes Seifenblasenbläserpack / Ein Tintenfisch zum Verlieben
programme.desc: Patrick möchte sich ein paar Dollar dazuverdienen und daher seinen Vorgarten vermieten. Thaddäus ist davon wenig begeistert - bis der erste Mietinteressent eintrifft, ein künstlerisch-musisch interessierter Herr, der gern Tee trinkt. Thaddäus' Begeisterung bekommt allerdings einen herben Dämpfer, als er von der heftigen Abneigung seines potentiellen Nachbarn gegen Quallenfischer und Seifenblasenbläser erfährt. Hektisch versucht er nun, SpongeBob und Patrick fern zu halten, und das Unheil nimmt seinen erwartungsgemäßen Lauf... // Völlig unerwartet verliebt sich Thaddäus Knall auf Fall in eine Kundin der Krossen Krabbe. Nachdem SpongeBob seinem Kollegen ein Date mit der Angebeteten verschafft hat, geht er mit ihm die Details einer solchen ersten Verabredung am praktischen Beispiel durch - bis Thaddäus der Geduldsfaden reißt..

programme.desc: Trinas Geburtstagswoche steht an, was Tori in die missliche Lage versetzt, sich endlich für ein Geschenk entscheiden zu müssen. Gesagt, getan: Tori und André performen den selbstgeschriebenen Song auf Trinas Geburtstagsparty, was diese allerdings überhaupt nicht zu schätzen weiß. Rock, Paper, Scissors: Paper and Pencil Tell a Joke / Scissors' Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Papier und Bleistift erzählen einen Witz / Scheres Orchester
programme.desc: Papier und Bleistift erzählen auf einer Party einen irgendwie lustigen Witz und sind schockiert, dass sie zum ersten Mal in ihrem Leben tatsächlich Lacher bekommen. Sie versuchen daraufhin, dieses Gefühl zu wiederholen, indem sie den Witz so vielen Leuten wie möglich erzählen - doch sie verstehen nicht, warum er nicht mehr so gut ankommt wie vorher. Schere bekommt einen Job und versucht absichtlich so schlecht zu arbeiten, dass er gefeuert wird - nur um den legendären Satz sagen zu können: ,Ihr könnt mich nicht feuern, ich kündige!' // Schere ist traurig und engagiert ein Orchester, das ihn überall begleitet und sein Leben musikalisch untermalt. Als Stein und Papier sich über die ständige Hintergrundmusik beschweren, fragt er sich, was hinter seiner Traurigkeit steckt, und erkennt, dass ihm Liebe fehlt. Außerdem ist die Frau seiner Träume die berühmte Schauspielerin Cate Blankett, und er hätte keine Chance bei ihr... außer ihre Beziehung wäre dauerhaft von romantischer Musik begleitet als wären sie verliebt.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants: Accidents Will Happen / The Other Patty
programme.sub-title: Verunfallt / Schwabbelburger
programme.desc: Thaddäus wird während eines Nickerchens im Lager der krossen Krabbe unter einem Regal begraben und erzählt nun einiges über Arbeitsunfälle und verstauchte Knöchel. Seine Drohungen, den Unfall der Obersten Werktätigen-Sicherheitsbehörde O.W.S. zu melden, sind erstklassiges Erpressungsmaterial gegenüber Mr. Krabs - aber wie lange wird er damit durchkommen? // Einmal mehr liegen sich Mr. Krabs und Plankton wegen der Krabbenburger-Geheimformel in den Haaren, als plötzlich eine neue Burgerbude an der Straße steht: Die "Schlappenburger" (2., 3. s.u.) werden zum Riesenerfolg und lassen unsere Streithähne nun wetteifern, wer als erstes das Rezept für diese Burger entwenden kann. SpongeBob wiederum ermahnt die beiden unermüdlich zur Kooperation - letztlich mit Erfolg, auch wenn er sich darüber kaum freuen kann..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 8
SpongeBob SquarePants: Drive Thru/The Hot Shot
programme.sub-title: Autoschalter / Heiße Reifen
programme.desc: Ein kleiner baulicher Mangel und ein fortschrittlicher Kunde lassen Mr. Krabs das Serviceangebot der Krossen Krabbe um einen Autoschalter erweitern. Dies erweist sich in mehrfacher Hinsicht als durchschlagender Erfolg, da Mr. Krabs aufgrund des großen Andrangs per Vorschlaghammer Schalter um Schalter eröffnet, bis nicht nur sein Personal, sondern auch das örtliche Straßennetz völlig überlastet ist... // Tony Junior, Sohn der Rennfahrerlegende Tony Flott wird in Mrs. Puffs Bootsfahrschule eingeschult. Tatsächlich hat der Junge das Talent seines Vaters geerbt, und tatsächlich scheint Mrs. Puffs Plan aufzugehen, dass ein wenig dessen auf den bislang unbelehrbaren SpongeBob abfärben möge - denn Tony Juniors Mantra "Lass los, sei cool" zeigt Wirkung. Bald sitzt SpongeBob sogar am Steuer eines Rennbootes! Leider ist das erwartungsgemäß der Anfang vom Ende..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: Skill Crane / Good Neighbors
programme.sub-title: Der Geschicklichkeitskran / Gute Nachbarn
programme.desc: In der "Krossen Krabbe" wird ein Spielautomat aufgestellt, ein Geschicklichkeitskran. Man wirft eine Münze in das Gerät und darf dann einen Kran mit Greifarm bedienen. Es gilt, damit ein Plüschtier zu packen, das man dann als Gewinn behalten darf. Doch ganz so einfach ist das Spielchen nicht, wie Thaddäus schmerzlich feststellen muss. Auch nachdem all sein Geld in dem Automaten verschwunden ist, hat er noch immer nichts gewonnen. SpongeBob kann sein Unglück nicht länger mit ansehen und gibt seinem Kumpel Nachhilfeunterricht in Sachen Geschicklichkeitskran. Thaddäus erweist sich als gelehriger Schüler und gewinnt schließlich einen Preis. Etwas übereifrig versucht er sich nun an einem echten Baukran - mit katastrophalen Folgen... // Sonntag in Bikini Bottom. Thaddäus gibt sich alle Mühe, die letzten freien Stunden vor dem Beginn der neuen Arbeitswoche halbwegs vernünftig zu gestalten. SpongeBob und Patrick lassen ihn aber keineswegs in Ruhe, sondern gehen ihm mit ihrem "Gute Nachbarn"-Club gehörig auf die Nerven. Daraufhin installiert Thaddäus eine High-Tech-Sicherheitsanlage, die ihn vor den Aktivitäten des Clubs beschützen soll. Doch das Gerät entwickelt ein Eigenleben: Als gigantischer Roboter stampft es plötzlich durch die Stadt. Wer kann es nur aufhalten.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: Selling Out / Funny Pants
programme.sub-title: Ausverkauf / Kaputt gelacht
programme.desc: Weil er endlich ein ruhigeres Leben führen will, verkauft Mr. Krabs die "Krosse Krabbe" an einen Fastfood-Konzern. Zunächst scheint alles glatt zu gehen. Das Restaurant ist nun Teil einer gigantischen Kette, und Krabs genießt die Ruhe, die er immer wollte. Schon bald muss er allerdings erkennen, dass sein Leben als Frührentner ziemlich langweilig ist. Krabs braucht eine neue Aufgabe - und findet sie als Aushilfskellner in der "Krossen Krabbe". Dabei stellt er fest, dass sein ehemaliger Laden dabei ist, seine unverwechselbare Identität zu verlieren. Gemeinsam mit seinen Ex-Angestellten SpongeBob und Thaddäus entwickelt er einen Rettungsplan... // Thaddäus geht das dauernde Gelächter seines Kollegen SpongeBob ganz schön auf die Nerven. Um endlich seine Ruhe zu haben, behauptet er, das Lachen sei Ausdruck einer schlimmen Krankheit, die dazu führen werde, dass SpongeBobs interne Lachbox explodiere. Die Folge: Der lebenslustige Schwamm werde nie wieder lachen können, wenn er sich in den nächsten 24 Stunden nicht zusammenreiße. Von nun an verkneift sich SpongeBob jedes noch so kleine Kichern, um am nächsten Morgen entsetzt festzustellen, dass er die Fähigkeit zu lachen völlig verloren hat. Statt dessen heult er von nun an ununterbrochen. Doch das kann Thaddäus noch weniger ertragen. Jetzt muss eine schnelle Lösung her.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: Dunces and Dragons (Lost in Time)
programme.sub-title: Der edle Ritter
programme.desc: Nach einem Zusammenstoß finden sich SpongeBob und Patrick plötzlich in einer mittelalterlichen Version von Bikini Bottom wieder. Die Einwohner halten die beiden für ritterliche Recken und verpflichten sie prompt, eine Heldentat zu vollbringen: Sie sollen König Krabs' Tochter Perla aus der Gewalt des bösen Zauberers Planktonamor befreien. Als Helfer stellt der König ihnen seinen Hofnarren Thaddäus zur Verfügung, der wegen erwiesener Unwitzigkeit zu nichts anderem zu gebrauchen ist. Notgedrungen bricht das ungleiche Trio zur Festung des Oberschurken auf. Doch der Weg dorthin ist weit und voller Gefahren. Die größte Gefahr geht von dem Schwarzen Ritter aus, einem verdächtig bekannt aussehenden Eichhörnchen. Und auch Planktonamors Feuer speiende Riesenqualle ist ein äußerst fieser Zeitgenosse. Sir SpongeBob und seine Gefährten müssen sich schon besonders ins Zeug legen, um sämtliche Unholde zu besiegen und ihren Auftrag zu erfüllen..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: Enemy In-Law / Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy VI: The Motion Picture
programme.sub-title: Wo die Liebe hinfällt / Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarschbube: Der Film
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs' Mutter sieht sich nach langer Zeit mal wieder nach einem passenden Ehepartner um. Als Krabs erfährt, mit wem sie sich trifft, ist er hellauf entsetzt: Es ist ausgerechnet sein Erzfeind Plankton! Natürlich ist er sofort davon überzeugt, dass Plankton wieder nur hinter dem Geheimrezept für seine Krabbenburger her ist - und tut alles, um Planktons Pläne zu entlarven... // Spongebob und Patrick sind außer sich vor Freude: Endlich kommt der neue Film mit ihren Idolen Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarschbube in die Kinos! Doch dort wartet eine herbe Enttäuschung auf sie - die Produzenten haben die beiden schon etwas in die Jahre gekommenen Superhelden durch junge, attraktive Schauspieler ersetzt. SpongeBob ist darüber so erbost, dass er beschließt, seinen eigenen Film mit Blaubarschbube und Meerjungfraumann zu drehen. Dafür holt er seine Idole auch gern aus dem wohlverdienten Ruhestand..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: Patrick SmartPants / SquidBob TentaclePants
programme.sub-title: Patrick SchlauKopf / Thaddäus TentakelKopf
programme.desc: Beim Fischen bekommt Patrick einen Schlag auf den Kopf ab und wird ohnmächtig. Als er wieder aufwacht, kann er nicht nur in vollständigen Sätzen sprechen - er ist auch zum brillanten Denker geworden, der alle mit seinen überragenden Geistesgaben beeindruckt. Alle bis auf SpongeBob. Der hätte lieber den guten, alten und etwas beschränkten Patrick wieder, mit dem er immer so viel Spaß hatte. Wäre doch gelacht, wenn sich das nicht bewerkstelligen lässt! // Sandys neues Teleportationsgerät funktioniert nicht besonders zuverlässig: Als sie es ausprobiert, verschmilzt es SpongeBob und Thaddäus zu einer einzigen Person. Das macht die Arbeit in der Krossen Krabbe natürlich recht schwierig. Doch Thaddäus hat ganz andere Sorgen: Für den nächsten Tag ist sein großes Klarinettenkonzert geplant. Bis dahin muss er wieder in seinem eigenen Körper stecken - oder SpongeBob während des Auftritts gut verstecken.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: Krusty Towers / Mrs. Puff, You're Fired
programme.sub-title: Dem Hotelier ist nichts zu schwer / Mrs. Puff, Sie sind gefeuert
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs hat einen neuen Plan, um noch mehr Geld zu verdienen: Er verwandelt die "Krosse Krabbe" in ein Hotel der Extraklasse, in dem den Kunden alle Wünsche von den Augen abgelesen werden. Zuständig dafür sind selbstverständlich SpongeBob und Thaddäus. Die beiden werden von den versnobten Gästen so lange mit Extrawünschen und Beschwerden bombardiert, bis Thaddäus völlig entnervt seinen Job kündigt. Am nächsten Tag kehrt er als Gast zurück - und bringt Mr. Krabs mit seinen absurden Forderungen an den Rand des Wahnsinns... // SpongeBobs Versuche, endlich seinen Bootsführerschein zu machen, sind gründlich daneben gegangen. Er ist so oft durchgefallen, dass er damit sogar einen neuen Rekord aufgestellt hat. Seine Bootslehrerin Mrs. Puff wird von ihren Chefs dafür verantwortlich gemacht und hochkant rausgeschmissen. SpongeBob fühlt sich schuldig und versucht zu beweisen, dass Mrs. Puff keine Schuld trifft. Er ist einfach von Natur aus ein schlechter Bootsfahrer..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: Chimps Ahoy / Ghost Host
programme.sub-title: Schimpansen Ahoi / Geisterstunde
programme.desc: Sandy ist in heller Panik: Die Schimpansen, die ihr das Geld für ihr Unterwasser-Baumhaus vorgeschossen haben, wollen zu einer Inspektion vorbeikommen. Jetzt muss Sandy beweisen, dass sie die Investition auch wert war und fleißig an hoch profitablen Erfindungen forscht. Doch ihre Ergebnisse sind eher dürftig. Damit der Eichhörnchen-Dame trotzdem nicht der Geldhahn abgedreht wird, beschließen SpongeBob und Patrick, ihre Erfindungen auf eigene Faust zu perfektionieren - mit nicht unbedingt perfektem Ergebnis... // Der Fliegende Holländer, eines der berühmtesten Gespenster der Welt, quartiert sich bei SpongeBob ein und erschreckt ihn rund um die Uhr - so lange, bis die Spuk-Eskapaden dem Schwamm nicht einmal mehr ein müdes Gähnen entlocken. Klar, dass Der Fliegende Holländer da geknickt ist. Hat er etwa sein Talent als Erschrecker eingebüßt? SpongeBob beschließt, dem alten Gespenst auf die Sprünge zu helfen..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: Whale of a Birthday / Karate Island
programme.sub-title: Der Sechzehnte Geburtstag / Der König des Karate
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs will seiner Tochter, der Walkuh Perla, den schönsten Geburtstag aller Zeiten bereiten. Während er die Party vorbereitet, wird SpongeBob dazu verdonnert, mit Perla ins Einkaufszentrum zu schwimmen. Der Schwamm soll unauffällig in Erfahrung bringen, was als Geburtstagsgeschenk für Perla in Frage kommt. SpongeBob kommt seiner Aufgabe gewissenhaft nach, aber auch er kann nicht verhindern, dass Mr. Krabs bei der Party wieder einmal an allen Ecken und Enden spart. Die Feier droht zum völligen Reinfall zu werden, doch zum Glück hat SpongeBob wenigstens bei den Geschenken nicht gespart - ganz im Gegenteil... // SpongeBob bekommt eine Einladung auf die geheimnisvolle Karate-Insel, wo ein großes Kampfsport-Turnier stattfindet. Der Sieger soll zum Karate-König gekrönt werden. Eine Chance, die SpongeBob sich nicht entgehen lassen will..

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf 4
SpongeBob SquarePants: All That Glitters/Wishing You Well
programme.sub-title: Alles, was glitzert / Wünsch dir was
programme.desc: SpongeBobs Bratenheber bricht beim Burgerbrutzeln ab. Was nun? Der Schwamm macht sich augenblicklich auf die Suche nach einem Ersatz - und findet den exquisiten französischen "Le Spatula"-Pfannenheber. Er würde einfach alles tun, um sich einen der filigranen Küchenhelfer zu beschaffen. Aber kann der auf die Dauer seinen guten alten Bratenheber ersetzen? Mr. Krabs lässt neben der "Krossen Krabbe"einen Wunschbrunnen graben. SpongeBob wird jeden Tag in einem Eimer hinunter gelassen und muss die Münzen einsammeln, die leichtgläubige Gäste hineingeworfen haben. Klar, dass der Brunnen nur ein Trick ist, mit dem Mr. Krabs noch mehr Geld scheffeln will - bis SpongeBob beschließt, die Wünsche der Kunden wahr werden zu lassen..

Obwohl die Geister nur eine Nacht Süßes-oder-Saures feiern wollen, bereiten ihnen SpongeBob und seine Freunde ein Halloween, dass sie vor ihrer Rückkehr nicht vergessen werden.//Beim Spielen fällt Garys Lieblingsball in einen tiefen Graben.
